scenes.text: For your team, it starts with a ready-made widget.
Add your brand. Shape the copy, choices, and result states.
Your developer connects the data and actions. Your team approves publication.
Build it once. Reuse the same branded experience across supported assistants, your website, and your app.
One experience to create, publish, and maintain. Your brand. Your workflows. Ready wherever your customers need you. Sail.
